text_block_list.text: Фудзи Кисэки's days are sweet as a dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Good morning, Fuji!
text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident

text_block_list.text:
Good morning! I'm so glad to be able to
see your
beautiful smile first thing in
the...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hm? Hold still for a second.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: There, got it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: U-um, was there something on me?
text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident

text_block_list.text:
Just a little flower petal. Hehe. Perhaps
it mistook
you for a fairy.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Swoon!
text_block_list.name: Rito Dorm Resident

text_block_list.text:
In the mornings, she treats the students
in her
dorm to lovely smiles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
E-excuse me, Fuji! I made some cookies
in home
ec today and was wondering if
you'd like them!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Wow, can I really have these? I'll be sure
to savor
them! Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Aaah! I did it! I gave them to her!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Say, Fuji... How many students have you
got
cookies from already today?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Let's see... Five, I think?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Five?! What the heck?! Is it Valentine's
Day or
somethin'?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Fuji! Please take these cookies too!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B

text_block_list.text:
A-and mine too! I was thinking of you
while I
baked them!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan C

text_block_list.text:
Why, my sweet ponies, there's no need
to rush!
I'm not going anywhere.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans

text_block_list.text:
At lunch, she captures the hearts of all
the
students on campus.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh my gosh! You look so regal and
beautiful
sitting by yourself and gazing
up at the night sky!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text:
Good evening, dear pony! It must be
fate that
brought us together this night.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Would you like to do a bit of stargazing
with me?
They're stunning today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: M-me?! But I don't want to be a bother!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. In fact, having you with me
would
make this moment all the lovelier.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Won't you give me the pleasure of
basking in
your company?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ohhh!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text: Hm? Is someone calling me?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm sorry for disturbing you!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So it was you, my precious pony?
Your
voice sounded so sweet, I thought
it was an angel.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If you have time, why don't you join me?
The
night sky is unbelievably beautiful
tonight.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Aaah!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text:
Oh my! I wasn't expecting it to rain. Time
to wrap
up my stargazing session.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hello there, lovely pony! Would you like
to head
back together since it's raining?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: O-oh, yes please!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan D

text_block_list.text:
And at night, she utterly enthralls any
student she
happens upon. Фудзи Кисэки's
days are sweet as a
dream.
